text: When an agent needs your call, it asks. Decisions waiting for you are counted on this icon, in every automation.
Each decision says what it wants to do, and why. Here, it wants to send the first email to a key account, and it shows you the exact draft.
Approve it, ask for changes, or don't send it. Not sure yet? Ask about it in chat first.
You also decide how much it does on its own. Ask first, run steps, edit the workflow, or full.
Start with ask first, and turn it up as you trust it. Your rules always hold. When a rule might be holding the goal back, it asks you, instead of breaking it.
